events.title: Sortie launched
events.detail: Ladakh Canyon Low-Level Tactical Sortie — ingress at 5,800 m AMSL, Auto-GCAS armed.

events.title: Fault 01 — CYLINDER_2_CHT_OVERHEAT
events.detail: CHT > 135 °C on Cylinder #2 on Cylinder #2 Head Assembly (ATA 72-00).

events.title: Prescriptive directive issued
events.detail: Enrich fuel trim +12%, throttle back 15%, descend into denser cooling air.

events.title: Fault 01 cleared
events.detail: Cylinder #2 Head Assembly returned inside the certified envelope.

events.title: Auto-GCAS recovery commanded
events.detail: Automatic 2.5 G pull-up at 1197 m AGL (TTI 2.5 s).

events.title: Fault 01 — CYLINDER_2_CHT_OVERHEAT
events.detail: CHT > 135 °C on Cylinder #2 on Cylinder #2 Head Assembly (ATA 72-00).

events.title: Prescriptive directive issued
events.detail: Enrich fuel trim +12%, throttle back 15%, descend into denser cooling air.

events.title: Sortie terminated — RECOVERED
events.detail: 44 s flown. Peak CHT 113.3 °C, minimum oil pressure 4.06 bar, final propulsion health 79.4%.
